pr_title: Add streaming custom data support to LiveTradingDataFeed
pr_body:
#### Description
- Added `SubscriptionTransportMedium.Streaming`
- Set `SubscriptionTransportMedium.Streaming` in live mode for the following classes:
  - `Tick`, `TradeBar`, `QuoteBar`, `OpenInterest`, `TiingoNews`, `PsychSignalSentiment`
- Updated `LiveTradingDataFeed` to handle streaming of live custom data

#### Related Issue
Closes #3785 

#### Motivation and Context
Enable streaming of custom data in the cloud.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No,

#### How Has This Been Tested?
- New unit tests
- Live algorithm receiving PsychSignal custom data

issue_context.title: Add streaming custom data support to LiveTradingDataFeed
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
`LiveTradingDataFeed` supports streaming custom data types

#### Actual Behavior
`LiveTradingDataFeed` does not support streaming custom data types

#### Potential Solution
n/a

#### Reproducing the Problem
n/a

#### System Information
n/a

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)

review_comments: One thing to note is that for custom subscriptions, this `Symbol` instance might have an `underlying` which is **used for equality** (https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/SecurityIdentifier.cs#L754) and the incoming data might not have the underlying set, so we need to assert the `underlying` is set in the data producer or remove it here  🤔

I think the data producer should be responsible for generating the correct symbol identifiers and setting the underlying symbol if required. If the symbol in the incoming data doesn't have the underlying set, the data handler will not be called and this is expected behavior, right?
